question.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
question.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${d}_{15}$, we remove the $1$st row and $5$th column: 

$$
D=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 2 \\ 0 & 8 & -2 & 0 & ∗ \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 & ∗ \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 & ∗ \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

 
So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{15}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${d}_{15}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{15} & =(-1)^{1+5}{M}_{15} \\  & ={M}_{15} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & -2 & 0 \\ 6 & 2 & -9 & 4 \\ 1 & 5 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & 3 & 10\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
